module.name: ibm_roks_bnk_cneinstance_single_nic
module.description: Deploy the BIG-IP Next CNEInstance component onto an existing IBM ROKS cluster using the upstream single-NIC CNEInstance module.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud API key used to discover the target cluster and VPC.

required.name: ibmcloud_cluster_region
required.description: IBM Cloud region where the existing ROKS cluster resides.

required.name: roks_cluster_name_or_id
required.description: Name or ID of the existing IBM ROKS cluster where CNEInstance will be installed.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resource_group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group used to discover the target cluster.

optional.name: flo_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where FLO is already installed.

optional.name: flo_utils_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for F5 utility components used by the CNEInstance deployment.

optional.name: f5_bigip_k8s_manifest_version
optional.description: Manifest version used to configure the CNEInstance deployment.

optional.name: far_repo_url
optional.description: FAR repository URL for BNK artifacts.

optional.name: flo_trusted_profile_id
optional.description: IBM IAM trusted profile ID created by the FLO deployment.

optional.name: flo_cluster_issuer_name
optional.description: Cluster issuer name created by FLO for mTLS certificates.

optional.name: cneinstance_gslb_datacenter_name
optional.description: Optional GSLB datacenter name for the CNEInstance configuration.

optional.name: cneinstance_network_attachments
optional.description: Network attachment definitions used by the single-NIC CNEInstance deployment.

key_outputs.name: target_cluster_name_or_id
key_outputs.description: Name or ID of the existing target cluster passed into the wrapper.

key_outputs.name: cneinstance_enabled
key_outputs.description: Whether the CNEInstance resource was enabled for deployment.

key_outputs.name: cneinstance_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the created CNEInstance resource.

key_outputs.name: cneinstance_id
key_outputs.description: Identifier of the created CNEInstance resource.

key_outputs.name: cneinstance_scc_policies_applied
key_outputs.description: Summary of SCC policies applied for the CNEInstance deployment.

key_outputs.name: pod_deployment_status
key_outputs.description: Pod deployment and readiness summary for FLO and utilities namespaces.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud credential template or project secret providing the API key.
